context: Open one failing run's raw workflow-run annotations (the startup-failure reason is not in job logs, since there are no jobs) to get the parser's complaint, then fix the offending expression. Confirm afterwards that a push to develop creates NO Seed Corpus run at all, since the workflow is dispatch-only.
description: Every push to develop produces a red 'Seed Corpus' run. Sampled the last 8 runs of .github/workflows/seed-corpus.yml: 8 of 8 conclusion=failure, spanning 2026-07-25T18:44 to 2026-07-26T10:41, most recently on 'chore(todo-db): weekly tracker export snapshot (#1313)'. Each failing run reports event=push, head_branch=develop, and jobs total_count=0 -- no job ever starts, which is the signature of a workflow startup failure rather than a failing step. That is doubly odd because the file on develop declares ONLY 'on: workflow_dispatch' (verified via git show origin/develop:.github/workflows/seed-corpus.yml), so a push should not create a run at all. The YAML parses cleanly with yaml.safe_load, so the defect is in something GitHub's workflow parser rejects rather than plain syntax -- candidates include the job-level 'continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.optional == true }}' expression and the matrix/name interpolation. Cost: develop shows a permanently red check that is unrelated to any change, which trains reviewers to ignore red and can mask a real failure. Noticed in passing while auditing CI during the 2026-07-25 follow-up batch; not caused by any PR in it.

deferrals.reason: The defect was a job-level 'if: github.event.inputs.benchmark == matrix.benchmark'. The matrix context is unavailable in jobs.<id>.if (it is evaluated before matrix expansion), so the expression is invalid and GitHub failed the whole workflow at startup -- a failed run with zero jobs on EVERY push, to any branch. Nothing catches this class statically: it is valid YAML, and the repo has no actionlint. I scanned all .github/workflows/*.yml and seed-corpus.yml was the only job-level offender (nightly.yml's matrix reference is a STEP-level if, which is legal), so no other file needs fixing today -- but the next one will not be caught either. A guard belongs in tests/unit/workflows/ (assert no jobs.<id>.if references matrix/strategy) or as actionlint in the lint lane; both are outside this item's only_modify allowlist of the single workflow file. Also noting rung 1 is post-merge-only by construction: it counts failures among the last 5 HISTORICAL runs, so it necessarily reports fail until the fix has merged and five further pushes have occurred.
deferrals.summary: No automated guard stops a job-level 'if' from referencing the matrix context again

preserves.behavior: The workflow remains manually dispatchable with its benchmark input

verifications.description: A push to develop creates no Seed Corpus run, or a green one
verifications.expected: exit 0 (no failures in the last 5 runs)
